operating_contract_synthesis: SAFE_LOWER_BOUND remains evidence-driven and distinct from OPERATING_CAP.
FAILURE_BOUNDARY remains unresolved until a credible duration failure is observed.
OPERATING_CAP requires repeated clean validation below boundary with safety margin.
SOFT_CUTOFF is a policy-stage admission threshold, not a Phase-A target.
HARD_CAP must preserve enough close reserve for durable checkpointing.
CLOSE_OVERHEAD should use empirical distribution across profiles/runs.
SAFETY_MARGIN should widen under noisy close/runtime behavior.
NEXT_TASK_ADMISSION should start simple and gain prediction only if measured benefit justifies it.
VALIDATION_CONFIDENCE must include count and workload-profile coverage.
ROLLBACK should respond to recent unexplained failures at/below cap.
Planned-gap optimization is downstream and separately measured.
Cooperative parallelism is downstream of strict cap validation and remains deferred.
